text:
omar: FYI finance / CS keep surfacing threads where the console shows the SA but billing spikes show a different project. customers are getting confused and opening tickets. can we discuss a safer telemetry model?

tara: yep. current problem is we write the billed project into billing pipelines but the UI reads pre-routing identity. mismatch.

lena: two concerns: (1) privacy/data residency for private installs, (2) cardinality if we start tagging metrics with project ids.

finn: what if instead of shipping raw project ids we emit a deterministic, salted short-hash (e.g., 8 chars) per routing decision? console would show "Billed: proj-4a3f" and drilldown would correlate via routing_hash -> event for authorized users.

omar: interesting. pros: low risk of leaking tenant ids in URLs, lower cardinality (fixed-length tokens), we can revoke mapping. cons: support needs mapping to explain to customers. we'll need access controls.

tara: UX: show "Billed (masked)" in the main tile and a small lock icon. Clicking it opens CS/SRE view with mapping (requires role). For customers themselves, we can offer an "unmask" button if they opt-in per-org.

lena: telemetry pipeline: metric path should remain low-cardinality: `auth.routing.fallback_total{reason,is_masked=true}`. full mapping events go to sampled sink but we persist mapping key -> effective_project in an ACLed store for 30 days. public logs never contain raw project ids.

finn: sampling strategy: emit full mapping event only when sampled OR if the ticket id is attached to the request (CS can flip sampling to 100% for a customer ticket). default global sample 0.5%. mapping store should be encrypted and only queryable by authorized tooling.

omar: alerting: keep metric-only alerts. e.g. soft notify if fallback_rate(org,30m) > 0.3%, escalate if >1% for 1h. metrics shouldn't depend on mapping existence.

tara: implementation sketch:
- router: at decision time generate `routing_mask = HMAC(salted_key, "proj:" + effective_project)[:8]` and a `routing_hash` for correlation. attach both to context.
- metrics: increment `auth.routing.count{reason,is_fallback}` and `auth.routing.masked_billed_count` (boolean tag).
- mapping event: sampled POST to secure store: {routing_mask, routing_hash, effective_project, ts} (store encrypted, ACLed).
- console: display masked id; drilldown uses `routing_hash` to fetch sampled mapping (requires permission).

lena: for private/dedicated deployments default to `telemetry.routing_mode=aggregated` and mapping store is local only. SaaS customers: mapping store is in our secure telemetry backend but masked ids are safe to show.
finn: social / process: add a CS runbook describing how to request an unmask for a ticket (auth flow + audit). also add audit logging when mapping is retrieved.

support-bot: linked ticket CS-4008: "billing mismatch - org: skylab". Sampling set to 100% for this org until triage complete.

omar: one more debate: do we need to expose billed_project at all to end-user UI? product wants clarity but privacy teams prefer masked-first. I vote masked-first with opt-in unmask.

tara: product agrees. masked-first reduces PR risk and still gives CS the tools to explain. will mock UI as "Billed: proj-4a3f (masked)" with tooltip: "This is a masked identifier for the project used for billing. Support can reveal if needed."

finn: security asks: routing_mask generation must rotate keys safely and mapping TTL must be enforced. ensure we have a key-rotation plan + one-way revocation.
lena: telemetry retention: mapping store 30d, sampled events 30d, aggregated metrics indefinite per current policy. pipeline changes behind feature flag `auth.routing.masked_telemetry`.

deploy-bot: router-canary-11 deploy queued. CI: green.

omar: I'll open PRs: (1) router change + mask generation, (2) telemetry pipeline mapping sink + ACL rules, (3) console masked UI + CS unmask flow, (4) runbook + alert rules. tagging @lena @finn for review.

tara: please drop PR links here. CS will need the runbook and the unmask flow before we ramp. goal: land canary, observe metrics for 24h, then 5% ramp.

finn: note for telemetry engineers: ensure `routing_mask` collisions are extremely unlikely (tweak length if needed) and include fallback to full-id local-only when collision detected.

omar: good point. we'll make mask 10 chars base32 to be safe and still compact.

lena: thanks all. I'll prepare the privacy checklist for the PR and confirm default configs for private vs SaaS.

omar: thanks. once PRs are ready I'll ping infra and CS. :thumbsup:
